scripts.demo:prepare: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply arcade-hub-local --local --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.dev:demo: npm run demo:prepare && concurrently -k -n worker,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/game-engine/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:integration: npm run demo:prepare && start-server-and-test dev:worker http://localhost:8787/api/health "tsx scripts/integration-smoke.ts"
scripts.test:load: npm run demo:prepare && start-server-and-test dev:worker http://localhost:8787/api/health "tsx scripts/load-test.ts"
scripts.build:web: tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && vite build apps/web --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:worker
scripts.preview: npm run build:web && npm run demo:prepare && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler dev --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --port 8787 --var DEMO_MODE:true --var NEW_LOBBIES_ENABLED:true
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler deploy
